title: From Common-Slot Chains to Heisenberg Central Products over Global Fields
summary: Let $F$ be a global field and let $p$ be an odd prime with $p\neq\operatorname{char}F$. Assuming first that $μ_p\subset F$, we record in a uniform global-field form the length-four common-slot chain for equal degree-$p$ symbol classes and emphasize the signed normalization adapted to explicit norm constructions. Thus, from \[(a,b)_p=(c,d)_p\in\textrm{Br}(F)[p]\] one obtains $x,y\in F^\times$ such that \[(a,b)_p=(x^{-1},b)_p=(x,y)_p=(c^{-1},y)_p=(c,d)_p.\] For number fields, the underlying chain is the length-four chain lemma of Gille--Szamuely, based on Tate's simultaneous local--global…
